title: Absent plaintiffs and personal jurisdiction
summary: Absent plaintiff class members do not face the same burdens as defendants compelled to defend, and the assigned cases protect them through the structure of representation and procedural safeguards.
notes: Shutts does not authorize blanket use of forum substantive law. Mussat does not eliminate Article III injury requirements for damages.

sections.Meaning: Absent plaintiff class members do not face the same burdens as defendants compelled to defend, and the assigned cases protect them through the structure of representation and procedural safeguards.
sections.How to work through the question: For a damages class, examine notice, opportunity to participate, meaningful exclusion, and adequate representation under Shutts. For jurisdiction over the defendant on absent claims, identify the separate question addressed by Mussat.
